subject: Request to move demo to allow sample-data + prompt prep
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>, Priya Nair <priya@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request to move demo to allow sample-data + prompt prep

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for scheduling the product demo next week (originally Wed, Jul 24). After syncing with our solutions team, we’d like to propose moving the demo out a few days so we have time to run a quick prep pass on sample prompts and workload traces and to verify your staging access. This will let us tailor the session to Acme’s actual workloads (prompt sets, token lengths, concurrency) and avoid a demo that’s too generic.

What we’re requesting from your side (short checklist):
- Sample prompt set (5–10 representative prompts, redacted if needed)
- Typical request/response sizes and expected p95 token length
- A small workload trace or CSV with timestamps (anonymized)
- Staging URL or S3 read-only credentials / IP whitelist for our SE to run quick smoke tests

I attached a short prep-checklist.xlsx that lists recommended artifacts and where to upload them. If you can share these by Tue (Jul 22) we can push the demo to Thu/Fri (Jul 30–31) or the week of Aug 4.

Can you let us know your availability for Jul 30–31 (afternoons PT preferred) and whether your infra team can provision a short-lived read-only S3 key or whitelist a Redwood IP?

If moving the demo is inconvenient because of travel, we can do a shorter, high-level session on the original date — but we think a later, tailored walkthrough will be higher ROI.

Thanks — happy to coordinate times.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: prep-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>

Cc: Priya Nair <priya@acme.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

On Fri, 18 Jul 2025 at 3:02 PM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for scheduling the product demo next week (originally Wed, Jul 24). After syncing with our solutions team, we’d like to propose moving the demo out a few days so we have time to run a quick prep pass on sample prompts and workload traces and to verify your staging access.

Totally fine with shifting — I’m traveling the week of Jul 21–25 and won’t be able to give the demo the attention it deserves. Jul 30 or 31 afternoons PT look doable for me and for Priya (our data lead). If possible we’d prefer Jul 31 afternoon — that gives us a couple more days to pull a sanitized sample.

We have a redacted sample I can attach now so you can start looking: acme-redacted-sample.csv (see attached). For the staging access, our infra team needs a short justification and a list of IPs to whitelist — can you provide the IPs or confirm if you can use a short-lived S3 pre-signed URL instead?

Also: do you need us to sign any additional NDA/DPAs before sharing sample data? We’ve already got the base contract in place but want to keep things compliant.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Head of Product, Acme Corp

Attachment: acme-redacted-sample.csv (text/csv)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to move demo to allow sample-data + prompt prep

Hi Samir — great, thanks for the sample. A few quick asks from the SE side so we can be ready for a deep, tailored demo: 

Prep items we will use (short):
- Representative prompt set (5–10) and expected p95 token length per prompt
- A short workload trace (CSV or JSON) with timestamps and response sizes; 1–2k rows is fine
- Redacted sample dataset (looks like the CSV you attached is a good start)
- Expected concurrency (typical RPS) and any spikes (e.g., nightly batch runs)
- Staging access: pre-signed S3 URL is easiest. If you must whitelist, our IPs are: 52.23.165.12, 18.197.42.8 (we’ll only use them for smoke tests).

If you can confirm the concurrency and send prompts and trace by Tue Jul 22 EOD we’ll schedule a dry-run on Wed Jul 29 at 13:30 PT with the Redwood demo team to validate the environment. Otherwise we can do the full demo Thu Jul 31 14:00 PT.

Also — no additional NDA needed for redacted samples. If anything is sensitive we’ll use the redacted artifacts and run locally against a small synthesized set.

Proposed live demo windows (all PT):
- Wed Jul 29 13:30 internal dry-run (Redwood prep)
- Thu Jul 30 14:00 customer demo (preferred)
- Fri Jul 31 14:00 customer demo (alternate)

LMK which slot works and I’ll block calendar slots.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Note: staging-access-instructions.txt will include temporary IPs and the README for the smoke test.

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Thanks Samir — Jul 31 would work but our internal availability favors Jul 30 14:00 PT (Dylan can run the demo and we’ll do a 30-min pre-demo at 13:30 PT to align).

Plan:
- You share the redacted prompt set and workload trace by end of day Tue Jul 22 (upload to the Drive folder in my email footer or reply with a pre-signed S3 link).
- Dylan will run a Redwood dry-run Wed Jul 29 13:30 PT to validate staging access.
- Customer-facing demo Thu Jul 30 14:00 PT (60 minutes) — agenda: 15m setup/context, 30m tailored walkthrough with your prompts, 15m next steps + mutual action plan.

I’ll send the calendar invite for Thu Jul 30 14:00 PT and include a 30-min internal buffer at 13:30 PT for the Redwood team. Rishi, can you create the invites and attach the Drive folder link?

On the DPA/NDA — thanks for checking. No further signature required for redacted artifacts. If you later want us to run on live, sensitive data we can surface that in the SOW.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
